ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High; approximately 82% high-intensity white surface vs 18% low-intensity black perimeter and central markings.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white contiguous region covering both lobes; thick black border along the trailing edge and tips; central vertical dark column at the peduncle junction with horizontal 'ladder' banding; small black point-clusters located in the lower-medial quadrant of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch; approximately 72-degree angle with a depth of 22% of total fluke vertical height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular macro-serrations; left lobe features 6 distinct peaks with moderate amplitude; right lobe features 5 distinct peaks with lower amplitude and higher frequency towards the tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trailing edge curve with a gradual upward sweep towards the distal tips; terminal tips are rounded and hook slightly posterior-ventrally.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Group of 5-6 circular tan/brownish high-contrast nodes located on the medial portion of the right lobe near the central dark marking.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Single prominent dark-red diagonal linear disruption on the far-left lobe; multiple faint horizontal grey rake marks on the distal tip of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent diagonal linear mark on the upper left lobe displaying red/brown pigmentation, suggesting non-pigmentary trauma or recent abrasion.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique tiered dark pigmentation pattern at the central notch base resembling horizontal striations or a 'tower' silhouette.
